_comment: Briscola locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action token '[play X]', the card labels (A, 2..7, J, Q, K), the suit symbols (carried in the {card}/{trump_card} slots), or numeric counts/points/scores. The '(TRUMP)' marker text may be localized.

_slots.{trump_suit}: The trump suit symbol (♠♥♦♣) - do not translate
_slots.{trump_card}: The trump card label, e.g. '7♠' - do not translate
_slots.{card}: A card label, e.g. 'A♥' - do not translate
_slots.{max_pos}: The highest legal card position in the player's hand
_slots.{count}: The number of cards a player holds
_slots.{pos}: A card's position number in the hand
_slots.{points}: A number of points (card value or accumulated score)
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered score line, or the final per-player score block
_slots.{winner}: The player number who won the trick or game
_slots.{tricks}: A number of tricks won by a player
_slots.{deck_count}: Number of cards left in the deck

game.start: Ciyaarta Briscola ayaa bilaabatay! Dabaasha Trump: {trump_suit} (Kaarka Trump: {trump_card})

prompt.intro: Waxaad ciyaareysaa Briscola - Ciyaaryahanka {player_id}. Goal: Ku guuleysta khiyaanooyinka oo soo uruuri dhibcaha ugu badan (120 dhibcood guud ahaan deck). Dhibcaha Kaarka: A = 11, 3 = 10, K = 4, Q = 3, J = 2, kuwa kale = 0 Card Power: A > 3 > K > Q > J > 7 > 6 > 5 > 4 > 2 Kaararka Trump waxay garaacayaan kaararka aan-trump-ka ahayn iyadoon loo eegin awoodda. Waxqabadka: '[play X]' halka X uu yahay booska (1-{max_pos}) ee kaarka gacantaada

trick.empty: Waxba kama jiraan kaararka ciyaaray weli xeeladkan.

turn.board: {hand} {trick} Dhibcaha: {scores} {trump_info} Kaararka ku ciyaar adigoo isticmaalaya [play X]

invalid_move.wrong_format: Isticmaal [play X] halka X uu yahay booska kaarka (1, 2, 3, iwm.)
invalid_move.out_of_range: Kaarka aan sax ahayn. Waxaad haysataa kaararka {count} (1-{count})

action.trick_win: Ciyaaryahanka {winner} wuxuu ku guuleystaa khiyaamada {card} wuxuuna helayaa {points} dhibcood!

outcome.head: Ciyaarta ayaa dhamaatay! Ciyaaryahanka {winner} ayaa ku guuleysta {points} dhibcood! Dhibcaha kama dambaysta ah: {scores}
